    U.S. Green Building Council

    USGBC accelerates and scales the transformation of the built environment. The evolution of LEED through LEED v5 sets a new standard for sustainable building, pushes boundaries, and creates efficient and extraordinary spaces.

    International Commerce Centre | LEED Platinum | Photo: Kai Shing Management Services

    News & insights

    Building a future where the built environment supports a healthy, sustainable world. See all articles.

    The 2027 Green Schools Conference has something for everyone
    6
    Whatever your role in green schools, GSC27 has something for you.
    Jay Fiore
    LEED v5 for Cities ratified by USGBC members
    2
    The rating system now moves toward launch, with availability for use expected in 2027.
    Sumner Byrne
    Webinar recap: "Radon and School Indoor Air Quality"
    2
    Learn about a Center for Green Schools webinar on radon and IAQ in schools.
    Lisa Greenfield
    Greening the game: How LEED is shaping the future of stadiums
    10
    Stadiums hosting sports and entertainment events have a unique path toward sustainability.
    Farah Qadeer
    2026 Greenbuild materials summit recap: Carbon, human health and circularity
    6
    Learn about the adoption of low-embodied-carbon, healthy, circular materials as discussed at the Greenbuild materials summit.
    Lyndsay Watkins
    Can a divided federal government deliver bipartisanship?
    4
    What the midterms mean for green building policy.
    Ben Evans
    Building the blueprint: Reviewing K–12 school district climate action plans
    4
    The Center for Green Schools reviewed 19 school districts' sustainability and climate action plans.
    Kyleigh Gunn

    LEED v5

    LEED v5 certification is here

    The Arc plaform supports exciting new certification capabilities alongside new resources. Get started.

    Citigroup Center | LEED Silver | Photo: CP Group

    Featured projects

    Green building has the power to impact businesses, the economy, our communities and the way we live. Explore how green building work is driving better decisions in design, construction and operations across our buildings, cities and communities.

    Olympic House

    Maxx Royal Bodrum Resort

    Ponce City Market

    International Commerce Centre

    Portobello Shop

    Citigroup Center

    Austin FC Stadium

    Our members

    USGBC members are leading the future of green building and driving impactful change.

    Introducing LEED v5

    How we build today will define tomorrow. LEED v5 sets a new standard for sustainable building. Currently available for BD+C, ID+C, and O+M.
